title: Observability and Evaluation
summary: This module provides comprehensive tools for monitoring, tracing, and evaluating LangChain applications. It includes callback handlers for event processing, a robust framework for assessing LLM outputs and agent trajectories, and seamless integration with LangSmith for enhanced observability and dataset-driven evaluation.

nodes.label: Callbacks & Tracing
nodes.title: Event Handling & Execution Tracing
nodes.description: Provides core components for handling events and tracing execution within LangChain applications, enabling observability and custom event processing. It includes base callback handlers, file-based logging, and utilities for managing and collecting run traces.

nodes.label: LLM Evaluation Framework
nodes.title: Comprehensive LLM Evaluation
nodes.description: Offers a robust framework for evaluating LLM outputs and agent trajectories. It includes various evaluators for parsing, QA, criteria-based assessment, and pairwise comparisons, leveraging LLMs and external tools.

nodes.label: LangSmith Integration
nodes.title: LangSmith Evaluation Integration
nodes.description: Provides tools and configurations for integrating LangSmith evaluation capabilities into LangChain applications. It enables running models or chains against datasets and collecting performance metrics.

nodes.label: Testing Utilities
nodes.title: LangChain Testing Utilities
nodes.description: Offers base classes and utilities for unit and integration testing of various LangChain components. It focuses on chat models and vector stores to ensure consistent behavior and feature support.

groups.label: Core Observability
groups.title: Core Observability Components
groups.description: The foundational module for event handling, logging, and execution tracing across all LangChain operations.

groups.label: Evaluation Systems
groups.title: LLM & Agent Evaluation Systems
groups.description: Modules dedicated to assessing the performance, quality, and behavior of LLMs and agents, both generically and via LangSmith.

groups.label: Quality Assurance
groups.title: Testing & Validation Utilities
groups.description: Provides tools and frameworks for unit and integration testing of LangChain components, ensuring reliability and correctness.
